name: [🥚] Find the Egg for a Brainrot
desc:
🥚 Welcome to Find the Egg for a Brainrot! ✨

👍 LIKE the game & join the community for FREE in-game rewards! 🎁
🏃 Grab as MANY eggs as you can — the farther from the center, the RARER they get!
☣️ The toxic cloud is closing in: reach the extraction pad in time… or lose ALL your loot!
🎒 Go for the GIANT eggs: heavier, but up to x5 hatch luck!
🔮 Hatch them in the cauldron, place your brainrots and earn cash non-stop — even offline!
📈 EVOLVE your brainrots (lvl 75) and rebirth to MULTIPLY your income
😱 Every 10 min: a COLOSSAL EGG + an apple rain in the village!
🤝 In a GROUP (X2–X5 doors): rarer eggs for everyone!
⛈️ Weather with exclusive mutations — equip the right tool!
🏋️ Train on the treadmills to run FASTER
🔄 Trade your brainrots with other players

🎁 Daily rewards + session milestones!

💻📱 PC, mobile & tablet · ⭐ Premium: x2 treadmill energy!
